eyebrow: Build and push, tagged by commit
code:
- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    context: .
    push: true
    tags: ghcr.io/northbridge-retail/cart-service:${{ github.sha }}
caption: Never latest — the commit SHA makes every deployed image traceable.

eyebrow: Point the cluster at the new image
code:
- run: |
    kubectl set image deployment/cart-service \
      cart-service=ghcr.io/northbridge-retail/cart-service:${{ github.sha }} \
      -n production

- run: kubectl rollout status deployment/cart-service -n production --timeout=120s
caption: rollout status blocks until every new pod is healthy, or fails the build.

code:
- run: |
    helm upgrade cart-service ./charts/cart-service \
      --install \
      --namespace production \
      --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }} \
      --wait --timeout 120s
caption: --install makes it upgrade-or-install; --wait blocks the same way.
